predecessors.name: Tiwanaku Empire
predecessors.text: the Bolivian homelands of the Pacajes (La Paz), Carangas and Soras (Oruro), Quillacas, Cara-caras and Chichas (Potosí), Charcas and Chuis (Chuquisaca)

successors.name: Inca Empire (Tawantinsuyu)
successors.text: the Bolivian homelands of the Pacajes (La Paz), Carangas and Soras (Oruro), Quillacas, Cara-caras and Chichas (Potosí), Charcas and Chuis (Chuquisaca)

ledger.x: c. 1150: the Aymara kingdoms take shape on the Altiplano. The kingdoms 'were developed between 1150 and 1477'; the page gives no independence date for any one kingdom.
1477: the Aymara kingdoms end under the Inca.
1477: end of the independent Aymara kingdoms (Colla 1450 and Lupaca c.

wars.name: Inca conquest of the Aymara kingdoms
wars.outcome: Pachacuti defeats the Collas (their ruler captured near Hatunqulla); the Altiplano kingdoms are absorbed in stages, 'well completed by 1500', with revolts until Huayna Capac.

certainty.note: No boundaries; departments stand for twelve kingdoms.
